propositions: Extract the exception-handling spine from run() (lines 555–629) into a standalone interpret_failure() function in structured_run.py, preserving arm order (UsageLimitExceeded → LLMError → broad Exception) to prevent silent reclassification of typed failures as outages.

Arm-ordering tests must assert type(x) is LLMConfigError (not isinstance) because LLMConfigError subclasses LLMUnavailableError, so a broad-first spine would silently misclassify sampling-parameter rejections.
The except spine is the densest code region in runner.py (58 lines at 20% comment) and extracting it provides maximum per-line headroom without requiring monkeypatch repoints.
Retarget 19 stale descriptive labels in test_llm_failure_matrix.py from wrong line numbers (346/365) to real anchors in structured_run.py (e.g., :84, :95, :131) so they cannot rot again.
Reduce runner.py LOC from 782 to under 700 headroom guard on this commit; run() stays responsible for the finally block (teardown, not interpretation).
